d:
The song portrays the artist's journey of perseverance, growth, and transformation. It reflects struggles with poverty, emotional battles, and societal judgment while emphasizing self-belief and hard work. Guided by his mother’s blessings, the artist rises from humble beginnings to achieve his dreams, overcoming obstacles with resilience. The lyrics celebrate the triumph of turning pain into purpose and finding success while staying grounded.
Song Credits:
Track Name: Sapne
Written & Performed By: Lashcurry
